review_scope: Finite source inspection of new numerical contract, recycle_common and run_stage identity/order/ownership. Audit-stage inspected only for links to previous stage and HTTP identity; this is not execution admission.

checks.worktree_binding: owned.W is rebound to new source and run_stage passes cwd=W explicitly; inherited default cwd is not used. imported ownership helpers use the rebound global for current tools.
checks.source_identity: frozen verifies current clean HEAD, build source commit/zero warnings/rc, runtime binary digest, frozen file digests, build source map and dependency digests/path resolutions before and after each owned service.
checks.first_test: Index0 requires no previous controller-start receipts, no host/numerical evidence, records fixed HTTP-first admission. First output/receipt paths are exclusive. No tests executed during this review.
checks.dependent_order: Every later service requires previous audited stage plus host/numerical PASS of same plan/source/binary; matrix also requires history contracts and matrix-coverage permission independently of speed passed boolean.
checks.retry_preservation: Output must not exist; owned save/open use exclusive mode; no retry loop. Failure and process cleanup are retained before stage finally record.
checks.ownership: run_stage gives command and original PID receipt to exact-unit cleanup fallback; process group owned by imported runner is separate session and cleanup checks live/zombie/errors. Source explicitly limits absence to owned entrypoints, not whole machine.
checks.numerical_source: One test requires deliberate changed=1 under true decode, router/BF16/full resident oracle, exact OFF/ON FP32, identical GPU mapping, changed writeback reused, sole mirror source retained, planned victim excluded after fixed all-hit recency refresh. Unknown and prefill context fresh pairs must remain inactive.
checks.numerical_peer_review: Source implementation agent independently traced three-step ring/slot/claim sequence and confirmed plans3, preferred=changed=published1, fallback2, negative gates0; no execution.

freeze_requirements: Final execution-plan frozen_files must contain exact group command files, recycle_common.py/run_stage.py/audit_stage.py, imported phase_common.py and dependency-admission.json; plan not yet created at review time.
Final admission must bind this source snapshot or re-review only changed scripts.
Host/numerical decision source maps must bind required-list, actual test binary, command/exit logs and strict PASS counts; numerical runner must reject skip.
limitations: Does not claim HTTP/performance/runtime correctness passed.
Numerical test is layer2/T1/C16/L28/K8/singleworker. Candidate HTTP covers actual multithread production path separately; no injected event/error concurrency stress.
Does not read model weight payload or execute model/test commands.
